How to use this

  • Fill the right two columns per row, then pick ONE row as the spine of each case study (Verizon, NPS, or onboarding are strongest).
  • Pair every public number with a private one you own — that's what turns correlation into contribution.
  • Anything marked — stays in your back pocket; don't publish it.
